$comment: Canonical source of every country map. `npm run maps:ingest` extracts maps listed in fromMaster from the master sheet and copies each declared override as canonical; an override is never overwritten by the master. The master stays unchanged as provenance.
policy: AIL follows a documented cartographic treatment for disputed territories. Boundary representations do not imply endorsement of territorial claims.
scope: 54 UN member states in Africa. Western Sahara is not a separate AIL map in this release.

master.role: Original AIL presentation master. Immutable provenance; default source for every map not overridden.

morocco.reason: The master's Morocco includes Western Sahara. AIL's approved cartographic treatment shows Morocco without Western Sahara.
morocco.treatment: Redrawn from Natural Earth subunit MAR, clipped at 27.661439°N (the Morocco–Western Sahara line in the same dataset); equirectangular, x scaled by cos(mean latitude); Douglas–Peucker simplified; normalised to the shared 19.6 longest side.

sources.dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural — Admin 0 map subunits (v5.1.2)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)

tanzania.reason: The master omits Zanzibar (Unguja and Pemba), sovereign Tanzanian territory.
tanzania.treatment: Master mainland outline kept unchanged in shape; Unguja and Pemba added from Natural Earth, placed by fitting Natural Earth's mainland to the master's.

sources.dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural — Admin 0 map subunits (v5.1.2)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)

mauritius.reason: The master omits Rodrigues, sovereign Mauritian territory.
mauritius.treatment: Master main island kept unchanged in shape. Rodrigues is added from Natural Earth at its true relative scale and true bearing from the drawing's centre, then moved inward along that bearing until it sits one inset gap (2.5 units: the 1.5 stroke plus one clear unit) clear of the existing drawing, so the ~560 km of open sea is shortened. Agaléga and other outer islets are not drawn.

sources.dataset: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural — Admin 0 map subunits (v5.1.2)
sources.licence: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
features: SU_A3=MUS (Rodrigues; main island for placement only)

equatorial-guinea.reason: The master omits Annobón, sovereign Equatoguinean territory.
equatorial-guinea.treatment: Master Río Muni and Bioko kept unchanged in shape. Annobón is added from Natural Earth at its true relative scale and true bearing from the drawing's centre, then deliberately moved inward along that bearing as an inset, sitting one inset gap (2.5 units: the 1.5 stroke plus one clear unit) clear of the existing drawing, so the open-sea distance is shortened. Placement against the master uses a fit of Natural Earth's Río Muni to the master's.
